data.context: In the 2020 IP Australia Economic Research Paper 10, *Intellectual property rights, business profitability and competition in the Australian economy*, section 3.2.1 reports econometric results on IPR ownership and business profitability. Using Australian business data from the 2016–17 BLADE frame, it compares profitable IPR-owning and non-owning businesses and describes links between past profitability, business age and current profits.
